title: the harmonizer reads the best view of a name of several genes
what: a feature named by a name several genes carry is converted to the top-ranked of them (or left ambiguous among them); the other carriers are candidates of the `all` view, which the harmonizer does not read
user_action: convert such names with `API.convert_many` and read the `all` view, or keep the feature unconverted
fixed_by: none (the harmonizer's design: one gene per feature)

title: a made-unique copy takes its feature's gene
what: a feature `X.1` or `X-1` beside a feature X of the dataset is read as X's copy (rule `made_unique_copies`) and summed into, or kept beside, X's gene
user_action: rename such features before harmonizing when they are other genes

title: the harmonizer's batch answers otherwise than a single call
what: a feature is converted otherwise in its dataset's batch than by `API.convert` alone
